scoring_justification: Exact DFT energies are method-dependent; score robust structural trends (binding energy ordering, linearity of bulk/interface decomposition, and presence of a nucleation barrier) that are independent of the specific computational implementation.

required.configurations: array of objects with keys: name (string), E_total (number, eV), n_H (integer), n23 (integer), epsilon_b (number, eV)
required.nucleation: object with keys: epsilon_b_infinity (number, eV), gamma (number, eV), R_squared (number), conditions (array of objects with keys: condition (string), mu_H (number, eV), n (array of integers), DeltaG (array of numbers, eV), n_star (integer), DeltaG_star (number, eV))

outputs.description: Contains computed binding energies and nucleation parameters derived from DFT total energies.

output_contract.notes: The artifact will be assessed for internal consistency, monotonic trends of εb(n), linearity of εb vs. n23/n (R²≥0.99), and presence of a nucleation barrier (ΔG(n) maximum at n>1 with negative asymptotic value) for the specified thermodynamic conditions. No exact reference values are required; the structural checks determine the score.

steps.description: Check monotonic increase of epsilon_b(n) from 1H to CH_infinite, correct isomer ordering (2H counter > 2H same), and closed-six-ring preference (12H incomplete less stable than 10H and 16H).
For compact closed-ring clusters (6H,10H,16H,24H,CH_infinite), verify linear dependence of epsilon_b on n23/n, R²>=0.999.
Check that DeltaG(n) curves for both conditions show a maximum at n>1 and negative asymptotic value at n=100, and are consistent with the agent's epsilon_b_infinity, gamma, and mu_H.
